summary: Whether an audio track is generated with the video.
combines: Supported on: Vertex only in practice. The Gemini Veo page states audio is "always on" for Veo 3, Veo 3 Fast, Veo 3.1, Veo 3.1 Fast, and Veo 3.1 Lite, and that Veo 2 is silent only, so there is no documented way to turn audio off on the Gemini Developer API. Vertex documents the boolean with default true.
Veo 2 never generates audio regardless of this field.
Veo 3.1 sometimes blocks a generation because of audio safety filtering; Google says blocked generations are not charged.
